verify_note: Capabilities change. Verify on the fab's capability page before ordering.

processes.label: 2 Layer 1.6 mm 35 um lead-free HASL (cheapest Beautiful Boards option, sets of 3)
notes: Source page (community.aisler.net/t/3735, last updated 07/07/2025): 'The rules listed here shall always be used as reference.' AISLER's older help.aisler.net design-rules page returned HTTP 503 / a TLS certificate mismatch on 2026-10-23 and was not used.

Copper: 'Trace width 200 um / 8 mil'; 'Copper spacing (copper/copper) 150 um / 6 mil'; 'Min. SMD pad size 200 um / 8 mil'; 'Copper to board edge 300 um / 12 mil'. 35 um finished copper (base foil 18 um plated up, per AISLER stackup threads) = 1 oz.

Vias: 'Min. via drill 0.3 mm / 12 mil', 'Max. via drill 0.45 mm / 18 mil', 'Min. via annular ring 200 um / 8 mil'; absolute minimum 175 um - 'For economic manufacturing of simpler boards, we may increase the drill size up to a diameter of 0.45 mm', so keep 200 um wherever possible. min_via_diameter_mm is null because no pad diameter is published (drill + 2 x ring = 0.70 mm is derived, not published).

PTH: drill 0.5-5.6 mm, 'Min. PTH annular ring 300 um / 12 mil'. Drills above 0.45 mm are treated as PTH and enlarged to compensate for plating. PTH slots 0.7-2.6 mm wide with 300 um ring. The .kicad_dru applies 0.2 mm ring to vias and 0.3 mm to through-hole pads.

NPTH: drill 0.5-5.6 mm; 'NPTH/copper spacing 250 um / 10 mil' (recorded as min_hole_to_copper_mm; no PTH-to-copper figure is published); NPTH slots >= 0.8 mm (>= 1.8 mm preferred, smaller slots are nibbled) with 300 um copper spacing.
'Min. drill-to-drill spacing 300 um / 12 mil'.
Silkscreen: line width 150 um, text height 800 um, silkscreen-to-pad 125 um, silkscreen on pads not supported, max 25% coverage per side (designs above are rejected).
Soldermask: 'Min. soldermask dam 100 um / 4 mil' - 'required for HASL'; suggested expansion 50 um.
Size: 'Min. board size > 10 mm'; 'Max. board size 500 x 500 mm'. Thickness 1.6 mm per the configuration title; no other thickness is published for this rule set.
Castellated edges: 'not supported' with HASL - order '2 Layer 1.6mm ENIG' instead. Also unsupported: buried/blind/micro/tented vias, user-defined subpanels, press-fit, countersink/counterbore.
Impedance: not specified on the 2-layer rule pages -> null.

Pricing (our-simple-pricing, posted 2023-08-27): 'PCB Price = Job Fee + Area x Area-usage Fee x Quantity'; 2 Layer 1.6mm HASL Budget EUR 12.00 + EUR 0.067/cm2, Blitz EUR 22.00 + EUR 0.129/cm2; 'Minimum order quantity is always 3'. Product page: 'Starting at just EUR 14.20'; Blitz 2-layer HASL 'manufactured from 2 business days'. Prices are dated; confirm live.

processes.label: 2 Layer 1.6 mm 35 um ENIG
notes: Source page community.aisler.net/t/3732 (last updated 07/07/2025): trace width 125 um / 5 mil, copper spacing 125 um, SMD pad 200 um, copper to board edge 300 um.
Vias: drill 0.25-0.45 mm, 'Via annular ring 100 um / 4 mil'. PTH: 0.5-5.6 mm, ring 300 um. NPTH/copper 250 um; drill-to-drill 300 um; PTH slots 0.7-2.6 mm; NPTH slots >= 0.8 mm.
ENIG: nickel 4.0-7.0 um, gold 0.05-0.1 um. 'Castellated edges: supported, manufactured free of charge.' Soldermask dam 100 um 'recommended but not required' with ENIG.
If you use small drills, castellated edges or fine trace/space AISLER requires ENIG. Unsupported: buried/blind/micro/tented vias, user-defined subpanels, press-fit.
Pricing (2023 post): Budget EUR 12.00 + EUR 0.097/cm2; Blitz EUR 22.00 + EUR 0.17/cm2; sets of 3.

processes.label: 4 Layer 1.6 mm 35 um ENIG (rules also valid for 0.8 mm)

stackups.name: AISLER 4 Layers 1.6mm 35um Stackup
stackups.notes: 'Final Thickness: 1.6 mm +/- 10%'. Layer thicknesses are published only as an image (attachment AISLER_Stackup_4L-1.6), not as text, so prepreg/core values are not recorded here. Published reference impedances (TOP referenced to IN1, BOT to IN2): 50 ohm single-ended 295 um width; 90 ohm differential 260 um / 135 um gap; 100 ohm differential 220 um / 150 um gap - stated as 'only' a basic orientation. 70 um-copper variants use 'variable' core/prepreg stock.

notes: Source page community.aisler.net/t/3733 ('4 Layer 35um ENIG Design Rules', last updated 07/07/2025): 'valid for 0.8 mm and 1.6 mm PCB thickness'. Trace width 125 um, copper spacing 125 um (no separate inner-layer value is given for the 35 um build; the 70 um HASL 4-layer build publishes 175 um outer / 125 um inner).
Vias: drill 0.25-0.45 mm, 'not adjusted by AISLER', ring 100 um. PTH 0.5-5.6 mm, ring 300 um. NPTH/copper 250 um, drill-to-drill 300 um, copper to edge 300 um.
copper_weight_oz [1] = 35 um outer; inner copper weight for the 35 um stackup is not stated in text (image only).
Castellation supported free of charge; no buried/blind/micro/tented vias; no user-defined subpanels.
Impedance: a reference table exists for the stackup but no controlled-impedance guarantee is stated -> null.
Pricing (2023 post): 4 Layer 1.6mm ENIG Budget EUR 14.00 + EUR 0.13/cm2; Blitz EUR 22.00 + EUR 0.347/cm2.
'Amazing Assembly': 'Double-sided, through-hole, SMD or mixed, down to 0201'; from one board ('One board is enough'). BGA capability is not stated. (products/assembly)
Parts: AISLER sources from integrated global distributors; customer-supplied parts accepted with a per-part handling fee; broker sourcing via a Project Manager. (products/assembly)

Price = bare board + components + assembly fee (setup tasks, per-panel tasks such as paste printing and reflow, per-component placement/inspection); total shown before checkout. No per-'extended'-part fee model. (products/assembly)

Lead time: SOURCES CONFLICT - marketing copy says 6 business days (Blitz) while the FAQ on the same page says a 2-layer assembly takes 9 business days or more including procurement; 4-layer longer. (products/assembly)

Data: 'We automagically import your native CAD data' - upload the native project (e.g. .kicad_pcb via AISLER Push for KiCad) so the BOM is built from the design. 'No assembly is possible with traditional Gerber files', even with a BOM and PnP; ODB++ is the fallback. (products/assembly, support-for-traditional-gerber-files)

Stencil: NOT included. A stencil is an optional add-on to a Beautiful Boards order ('If your project has paste layers, you can add a stencil to the same order'; one paste layer = one-sided stencil). 2023 pricing: 'Stencil Price = Job Fee + Area x Area-usage Fee x Factor(double-sided)', job fee EUR 5.00, EUR 0.095/cm2. (products/boards, our-simple-pricing)

file_requirements.gerber_format: Native .kicad_pcb preferred; Gerber (X2 and classic dialects auto-detected) accepted for bare boards only
file_requirements.drill_format: Excellon-style .xln, 2:4 precision, inches (for Gerber uploads); not needed for native uploads
notes: Native KiCad upload is supported: 'we support KiCad natively'; upload the .kicad_pcb or, 'for the best experience', use the 'AISLER Push for KiCad' plugin (Plugin and Content Manager), which exports Gerbers, an IPC netlist (for Smart Tests), BOM and pick-and-place and uploads them in one click; later pushes become new revisions. KiCad 10 file format is supported (plugin >= 0.6.0). (community/t/kicad/88)

KiCad 5 .kicad_pcb uploads can produce overly thin thermal reliefs - export Gerbers locally or upgrade to KiCad 7+. KiCad 7/8 custom fonts are not embedded and the import server lacks them - use the plugin or local Gerbers. (community/t/kicad/88)

Gerber uploads: 'understands many Gerber file dialects, e.g., Gerber X2 and naming patterns'; expected names project_name.<layer>.ger (toplayer, bottomlayer, topsoldermask, boardoutline, internalplane1..n ...), drills project_name.drills_pth.xln / holes_npth.xln at 2:4 precision in inches; outline layer must contain only the outline; avoid special characters; multiple files per layer may be zipped and are merged. (support-for-traditional-gerber-files)

Supported native tools listed on the product page: Altium Designer, KiCad, Autodesk EAGLE, Target, Fusion 360, DipTrace, Sprint Layout, Pulsonix, Zuken, LibrePCB, Fritzing, Horizon EDA. (products/boards)
AISLER publishes design-rule files for Eagle, KiCad and DipTrace on GitHub (linked from each design-rules page); the DRU files in this kit are independent transcriptions of the published numbers.
